source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Can help prevent infection with these vaccine-preventable forms of viral hepatitis, an important preventive measure, particularly for clients with existing liver disease from other causes","B":"Being relevant mainly for healthcare workers themselves who are at occupational risk, rather than for clients living with liver disease more broadly","C":"Carrying fairly little established role much in helping to prevent additional liver disease from developing over the course of someone's life","D":"Guaranteeing complete, lifelong protection after just a single dose, regardless of whether the full recommended vaccination series is ever actually finished by the client"}}
source_row.rationale: Hepatitis A and B vaccination can help prevent infection with these vaccine-preventable forms of viral hepatitis, an important preventive measure recommended broadly and particularly emphasized for clients with existing liver disease from other causes, who may be at increased risk of severe outcomes if additionally infected with viral hepatitis.
